div.div: 6 خَرَجُوا يَتَرَاكَضُونَ [They went forth contending together in urging their horses]. (A.) And تراكضوا إِلَيْهِمْ خَيْلَهُمْ [They contended together in urging towards them their horses] (S, A) حَتَّى أَدْرَكُوهُمْ [until they overtook them, or came up to them]. (A.) And فِى الحَلْبَةِ ↓ ارتكضوا [app. signifies They urged their horses in the raceground]. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
